source.citation: Fiscal Information Agency, Ministry of Finance: comprehensive income tax statistics by village (綜合所得稅所得總額各縣市鄉鎮村里統計分析表), income year 2023

method: sigma = (ln Q3 − ln Q1) / (2 × 0.6745), from the first and third quartile of the district total row of the FIA comprehensive income tax statistics by village, income year 2023. The household income of a citizen at percentile p is the district householdIncome × exp(sigma × z(p)). Limits: FIA income is per tax unit, not per household, and excludes transfer income; the log-normal shape is an approximation. Same input and formula as the rent ghost rule (scripts/pipeline/params/ghost.ts).
